# Flame v2.7.2

- Improve the empty Applications page and preserve access to the Add action for authenticated users.
- Mount the application form only when opened; hide Edit when no applications exist and reset editing after the last application is removed.
- Validate application list responses, display a retryable error for invalid responses, and clear stale errors after a successful reload.
- Add Chromium regression coverage for navigation from Home, direct access, guest access and recovery from malformed responses.

Docker images are published for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
